title: Hard cutoff and gauge theories
summary: According to usual calculations, the use of a hard cutoff $Λ$ in gauge theories leads to a violation of gauge invariance. This seems to generate a tension between gauge theories and the Wilsonian effective field theory (EFT) paradigm, where $Λ$ has the physical meaning of ultimate scale of the theory, the scale above which the latter has to be replaced by its UV completion. In the present work, considering the Euler-Heisenberg correction to the free Maxwell action, we present a way to introduce the Wilsonian hard UV cutoff $Λ$ that preserves gauge invariance at the quantum level.
